config.title: Carmen Ghirardi
config.description: I am a full stack developer actively searching for a job in Sweden

intro:
Hello, I’m Carmen!
A developer with 10+ years of experience now based in Malmö, Sweden.

I’m a passionate full stack developer working at a Swedish tech company, while also pursuing personal projects and selective freelance collaborations. Living in Sweden has strengthened my appreciation for its culture of innovation, inclusivity, and balance — values that align with how I build and collaborate.

My expertise lies in developing thoughtful management and communication platforms for companies and private clients. I love turning complex ideas into elegant, functional solutions with a focus on usability, collaboration, and long-term impact.
footer: Born on January 21st, 1989, I am a proactive and dedicated individual with a strong passion for technology, nature, and collaborative teamwork. I thrive in dynamic environments where I can contribute, learn, and grow alongside others. In addition to my technical expertise and hobbies, I possess a valid driver’s license (Category B) and own a car, which allows me to be flexible and mobile for both professional and personal commitments. I am always eager to learn, grow, and embrace new challenges with an open mind.

I am excited about the opportunity to connect and explore new professional opportunities in Sweden. I look forward to contributing my skills and passion to a dynamic environment. Please feel free to reach out if you would like to discuss how I can bring value to your team or project.

I’m embarking on this exciting new chapter of life with my partner — both in love and work — Alessandro. He’s the most talented PHP backend developer I know. Take a look at his work!

skills.title: Web Frontend
skills.description: My strongest and most accomplished skill. Ever since I was 11, I’ve been captivated by the art of designing websites. My journey began with coding a project dedicated to my favorite anime, and that early passion has only grown stronger over the years. Today, I turn ideas into engaging, functional, and user-friendly web experiences.

skills.title: Web Backend — API
skills.description: I can’t imagine a life without coding — the satisfaction of turning a problem into a solution and seeing it come to life with a triumphant “It works!” is unmatched. My journey with programming began in high school, and it has been a defining passion and integral part of my life ever since.

skills.title: Design — Graphics
skills.description: Designing user navigation experiences is the most entertaining part of my work. I take inspiration from well-crafted experiences I encounter daily, reimagining them to fit the unique needs of my clients. My goal is to create designs that are not only visually appealing but also functional, ensuring that every interaction feels natural and effortless.

skills.title: App
skills.description: From custom management systems to app versions of websites, the ability to offer software-like solutions enhances client satisfaction and adds value to their digital presence.

skills.title: Teamwork — Tools
skills.description: Last but not least, my teamwork and project management skills, developed over years of experience as an employee and through collaborations with other professionals. I have managed projects created by multiple contributors and have taken on various roles within the overall design process.

education.annotation: Beyond formal education, I have independently expanded my expertise in web development through self-directed learning and personal projects. I developed strong skills in PHP for backend development and advanced knowledge of frontend technologies like HTML, CSS, JavaScript. This combination of formal training and self-taught knowledge has enabled me to stay current and adaptable in the ever-evolving tech landscape.

items.description: Driven by a desire to take a break from academic studies and contribute meaningfully to society, I decided to join a volunteer program. The opportunity arose when the wife of my programming professor, who managed a cooperative participating in the social service volunteer program, warmly welcomed me to join their initiatives.
tasks: Facilitated activities as an animator and provided social support to groups of young people, fostering teamwork and personal development.
Assisted and supported individuals with disabilities, ensuring their inclusion and active participation in community programs.
Offered childcare and educational support in a preschool environment, helping to organize activities and provide hands-on assistance to teachers.
Worked alongside individuals recovering from challenging experiences, including former inmates, to assist in their reintegration and personal growth through structured activities and mentorship.

title: 2005 — 2009
Technical High School specializing in Computer Science
items.description: From an early age, I have been passionate about software development and the creative problem-solving it entails. Choosing to specialize in computer science allowed me to turn that passion into practical skills, laying the foundation for my career in technology. During my studies, I delved into both software and hardware topics, exploring the world of programming and system design.
tasks: Learned functional programming concepts and languages, including C and Assembly, to develop a deep understanding of how systems operate at a fundamental level.
Transitioned to object-oriented programming, mastering languages like Java, C++, and C#, and applying these principles to build efficient, modular applications.
Gained advanced knowledge of hardware technologies, with hands-on experience in system architecture and technical components.
Explored web development within the .NET framework, building robust, data-driven applications.

passions.text: I have a deep love for animals and I am especially connected to my own dog and cat, who have been a constant source of joy in my life. Their well-being is a top priority, and I’m committed to bringing them with me as I start a new chapter in Sweden.

Nature has always been a source of inspiration for me, particularly mountains and snowy landscapes. I find peace in hiking through these environments, breathing in fresh air, and sharing these experiences with my life partner, who shares my love for the outdoors.

Gaming is one of my favorite ways to unwind, whether playing on consoles and PC or watching others play — a relaxing habit I enjoy with my partner. I also have a deep passion for card games, especially Magic: The Gathering, which I find both strategic and endlessly fun.

Cooking is another creative outlet for me, particularly when preparing vegetarian and vegan dishes. It’s a way for me to connect my love for animals and nature with something tangible and enjoyable. While I sometimes wish I were less passionate about food :-), I truly love both the process and the flavors that come with it.
